Delete a Payslip Batch

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to delete a payslip batch that was created by mistake and has no confirmed payslips.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

3. Batches

Click Batches.

4. Find the payslip batch

Type the name of the payslip batch and press Enter.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the payslip batch.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Delete

Click Delete.

8. Confirm

Click Delete in the window to confirm.
